title: Card Security Schedule: Loss Protection and Replacement Settings for Cartwise Gift Cards
content:
Card security keeps the loss and replacement settings of each Cartwise Gift Cards card type in one schedule: the evidence a replacement relies on, the replacement fee, how many replacements a card may have in a calendar year, and the fraud review target.

## Schedule 1 — Replacement evidence, fee and allowance

| Card type | Replaced only if registered before the loss | Unregistered lost card needs the purchase receipt | Replacement fee | Replacements per card per calendar year |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | No | Yes | 0.00 | 2 |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | Yes | Yes | 5.00 | 1 |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | Yes | No | 0.00 | 2 |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | No | Yes | 0.00 | 1 |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | Yes | No | 0.00 | 1 |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | No | Yes | 0.00 | 3 |

Fees are in US dollars.

## Schedule 2 — Suspension, protection and fraud review

| Card type | Loss report suspends the card at once | Balance protected from | Replacement fee taken from the protected balance | Target to finish a fraud review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise eGift Card | Yes | The time of the loss report | Yes | 5 business days |
| Cartwise Plastic Gift Card | Yes | The time of the loss report | Yes | 5 business days |
| Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card | Yes | The time of the loss report | Yes | 5 business days |
| Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card | Yes | The time of the loss report | Yes | 5 business days |
| Cartwise Corporate Gift Card | Yes | The time of the loss report | Yes | 3 business days |
| Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card | Yes | The time of the loss report | Yes | 2 business days |

## Column definitions

- **Replaced only if registered before the loss.** Yes means a lost card of that type can be replaced only if it was registered before the loss.
- **Unregistered lost card needs the purchase receipt.** Yes means a lost card of that type that is not registered needs the purchase receipt for a replacement.
- **Replacement fee.** The fee to replace a lost or stolen card. Only the Cartwise Plastic Gift Card carries a fee, 5.00; every other type is 0.00.
- **Replacements per card per calendar year.** The number of replacements allowed for one card in one calendar year: 2 for the Cartwise eGift Card and the Cartwise Reloadable Gift Card, 1 for the Cartwise Plastic Gift Card, the Cartwise Holiday Bonus Gift Card and the Cartwise Corporate Gift Card, and 3 for the Cartwise Corporate Premium Gift Card.
- **Balance protected from.** The moment from which a replacement protects the balance. For every card type it is the time of the loss report.
- **Fee from the protected balance.** Yes means the replacement fee is taken from the protected balance of the card being replaced.
- **Fraud review target.** The target, in business days, for finishing a fraud review of a suspended card.
